Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full sales-pipeline payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"My pipeline","periodLabel":"This quarter · QTD","updatedText":"Updated 2 min ago","currency":"USD","openTotal":1420000,"deltaPct":8,"deltaText":"vs last quarter","stages":[{"label":"Prospecting","amount":420000},{"label":"Qualification","amount":380000},{"label":"Proposal","amount":350000},{"label":"Negotiation","amount":270000}],"stats":[{"label":"Open opportunities","value":"12"},{"label":"Closing this month","value":"$320K"},{"label":"Win rate (QTD)","value":"34%","state":"good"},{"label":"Avg deal size","value":"$118K"}],"submitText":"Open in CRM"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): card heading; defaults to 'My pipeline'.
- 'periodLabel' (string, optional): small eyebrow above the title, e.g. 'This quarter · QTD'.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): freshness label shown with a live dot, e.g. 'Updated 2 min ago'.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code; defaults to USD. Drives money formatting.
- 'openTotal' (number, optional): total open pipeline amount; shown as the big hero number (e.g. 1420000 renders '$1.42M'). Omit everything to show sample data.
- 'deltaPct' (number, optional): quarter-over-quarter change as a percent; positive renders green (up), negative red (down).
- 'deltaText' (string, optional): short qualifier after the delta, e.g. 'vs last quarter'.
- 'stages' (array, optional): open pipeline by stage, each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'amount' (number, REQUIRED) }. Rendered as a segmented bar + legend.
- 'stats' (array, optional): headline stat tiles, each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'value' (string, REQUIRED), 'state' (optional: 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad' to color the value). Typically Open opportunities, Closing this month, Win rate, Avg deal size.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label, e.g. 'Open in CRM'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): message sent back when the button is tapped.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
